mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over the past 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3%, it signals an overheating economy that will prompt the Fed to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show y-o-y growth above 5%, it signals a strong consumer-led expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS show y-o-y growth > 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200k per month, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k/mo but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL > 3% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is in a y-o-y decline and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals an economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO y-o-y decline and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: INDPRO declining y-o-y and UNRATE rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
